title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - KeyPerformanceIndicator
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/KeyPerformanceIndicator. A Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is a type of performance measurement; KPIs evaluate the success of an organization or of a particular activity in which it engages (definition taken from FIWARE, http://fiware-datamodels.readthedocs.io/en/latest/KeyPerformanceIndicator/doc/spec/index.html). This class holds the general, reusable definition of a KPI (e.g. 'road congestion'); its individual, timestamped values are represented separately as KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment entities, related to this one via s4city:quantifiesKPI.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'KeyPerformanceIndicator'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasName.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasName'. Name of the KPI, e.g. 'Road congestion'.

hasDescription.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasDescription'. Natural-language description of the KPI.

hasCalculationPeriod.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasCalculationPeriod'. ISO 8601 duration (xsd:duration) over which the KPI is calculated, e.g. 'P1D' for a daily KPI.

isKPIOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/isKPIOf'. The saref:FeatureOfInterest (e.g. a road segment) this KPI is defined for. Inverse of saref4city:hasKPI (declared on saref:FeatureOfInterest, outside the scope of this candidate).
